message.title: Welcome!
message.body: Thank you for visiting my test world! This world is in its early design phase. For an example of what the final product might look like, check out City of Glass 2. Changelog: • Changed Roll to Ctrl on Desktop • Fixed some stairs and pipes problems • Scaled down mini world map • Added support for VRC Third Person view
